title: Skyblock all in one
description: A Hypixel SkyBlock modpack including all the mods you could ever need, alongside beautiful texture packs and shaders for the brave ones who want to push their pc further.
body:
This collection is basically where I keep my Skyblock modpacks for Hypixel. Right now it’s just one pack, but I’m planning to expand it over time with different versions depending on what I feel like making. The current one is pretty heavily modded and built around having a lot of useful features in one place, so it’s definitely more on the “full setup” side rather than something super minimal.

I’ve spent a lot of time putting it together and tweaking things so it actually feels good to use in-game. It’s not just about throwing in a bunch of mods, it’s about making sure everything works well together and actually helps instead of getting in the way. The goal is to make Skyblock smoother, more organized, and less frustrating, especially when you’re grinding or managing a lot of different things at once.

As I add more packs later on, I’ll probably experiment with lighter or more specialized setups, but for now this collection is centered around one solid, feature-heavy pack that covers pretty much everything I personally want while playing.
